ravi: quick smoke report from a q3 bring-up for sorrel-lite on staging. short multilingual suite (ja / zh-Hant / ar) shows drops and a weird bidi/punctuation mirror in an en->ar mixed sample. repro + tiny examples below. anyone seen ZWJ/empty-token patterns after quant backend changes?

ravi: repro command:
```
./eval_locale --model=sorrel-lite --quant=q3 --locales=ja,zh-Hant,ar \
  --dataset=short-multilang-2026 --metrics=bleu,chrf --seed=99 --batch=48
```

ravi: snapshot (float32 -> q3):
```
locale     float32_bleu  q3_bleu  float32_chrf  q3_chrf
ja         31.4          26.8     48.3          43.0
zh-Hant    27.9          23.6     44.9          39.3
ar         40.2          38.7     (N/A)         (N/A)
```

tina: example (ja) showing dropped char after detok:
src: "\u65e5\u672c\u8a9e\u306e\u30a2\u30d7\u30ea\u3002"
ref: \u65e5\u672c\u8a9e\u306e\u30a2\u30d7\u30ea\u3002
q3_out: \u65e5\u672c \u8a9e\u306e\u30a2\u30d7\u30ea\u3002  (extra space inserted between kanji pair)

cheng: I ran tokenize-diff against bundler-embedded tokenizer vs runtime lib. outputs:
```
float tokenize("\u65e5\u672c\u8a9e\u306e\u30a2\u30d7\u30ea\u3002") -> ["\u65e5\u672c\u8a9e","\u306e","\u30a2\u30d7\u30ea","\u3002"]
q3  tokenize("\u65e5\u672c\u8a9e\u306e\u30a2\u30d7\u30ea\u3002") -> ["\u65e5","\u672c","","\u8a9e","\u306e","\u30a2...","\u3002"]
```
cheng: empty token present before \u8a9e; that causes detok to introduce a space. same root cause appears in zh-Hant with ideographic-hyphen + ZWJ combos.

tina: ar mixed example shows mirrored punctuation after q3 detok:
src (en->ar mixed): "Today (meeting) announced."
q3_out: "Today )meeting( announced."  (paren directions flipped around Arabic run)

cheng: That looks like resegmentation changed token order or introduced zero-width tokens that confuse our post-detok bidi normalization. Packaging check: q3 image includes tokenizers@2.0.1, float image had tokenizers@2.1.0. model-bundle checksum identical.

ravi: Plan: (1) add quick detok filter to collapse empty tokens and strip stray ZWJ/ZWSP before scoring (short-term), (2) add deterministic tokenizer runtime checksum to bundle and fail-on-mismatch in model loader (long-term), (3) add unit tests for katakana adjacency, ideographic-hyphen, and bidi punctuation adjacency.
